description: Good decision: both is_loopback_addr and is_loopback_url_host in util.rs return false on any parse error. The comments state this explicitly ('fail-safe — do not grant loopback privileges to unrecognised input'). The invariant means that a malformed or exotic address string can never accidentally satisfy a loopback check and bypass a security guard. The same pattern holds for is_loopback_url_host where a URL missing '://' is treated as non-loopback.
title: DECISION: parse errors default to non-loopback
